items.text: On this team, I can acknowledge a mistake without fear of embarrassment.
On this team, I can ask for help without others thinking less of my abilities.
On this team, I can raise concerns without being judged as troublesome.
On this team, I can question a decision without being punished for it.
On this team, admitting uncertainty would cause others to lose respect for me.
On this team, expressing an unpopular opinion could lead to rejection by others.
On this team, asking a basic question could lead to ridicule.
